First cell match reference front ear; last cell shows mostly orange BACK of the ear with only a tiny inner white rim. Each cell contains entire ear with comfortable transparent padding around ALL sides, including beneath base; no hair, face, head, jewelry, labels or anatomy charts. Lower 15% of each ear is a rounded orange furry attachment stump matching reference. Painterly anime illustration with detailed smooth brush texture, matching the supplied character. This is not a diagram: ready-to-use high-quality painted animation art. Transparent pixels around every separated ear. Prefer a large 2048x1536 atlas. Do not add any decoration or background.
